lyrics.text:
春风吹过小河旁
白云落在青山上

phrases.human_summary: 春风吹过小河旁：7 个音节，7 个音符，音准命中 7/7，平均偏差 -5.1 音分
白云落在青山上：7 个音节，7 个音符，音准命中 7/7，平均偏差 -0.4 音分

method_notes.pitch: per-frame autocorrelation versus cepstrum candidate selection using harmonic comb strength, coverage, band priors and voiced-periodicity confidence
method_notes.smoothing: isolated-octave correction with raw observations retained; local-rate adaptive median windows (3-9 frames)
method_notes.notes: pitch-jump, energy-dip and voicing-drop boundaries; short fragments merged by pitch proximity
method_notes.alignment: monotonic note-to-syllable partition with melisma merge, then category-aware onset/vowel boundary alignment
